metadata.description: Official Xpoz plugin for Claude Code - social media intelligence across Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, and TikTok

plugins.name: xpoz
plugins.description: Social media intelligence powered by Xpoz. Search, analyze, and export data from Twitter/X, Instagram, Reddit, and TikTok. Includes 9 skills: best practices reference for query syntax, pagination, field selection and all platform tools; getting started onboarding and setup; social tracking for continuous keyword/user/hashtag monitoring; sentiment analysis across platforms; Twitter data export to CSV (up to 500K rows); influencer discovery and ranking; Reddit discussion research; competitive intelligence and brand comparison; security OSINT and threat monitoring.
